author: IGN
description:
Right now, consoles are not exactly flying off shelves - generally, raising the price of things by several hundred dollars doesn’t make people MORE inclined to buy them - but if a recent report is to be believed, they might soon be in very high demand.

The Game Business reported that a senior buyer for a “major retailer” spoke anonymously to them about the likelihood of shortages later this year, claiming “We’ve been informed that because of the on-going issues around hardware component availability, we won’t be getting the units we want ahead of GTA. Demand will likely outstrip supply during the year end period.”

Max has all that and more on your Daily Fix!
title: “Major Retailer” Issues Warning of Console Shortages Ahead of GTA 6 - IGN Daily Fix

author: IGN
description:
The End of Evangelion from Hideaki ANNO return to theatres July 22 EVANGELION 30th Movie Fest. Check out the trailer for the theatrical event here!

This final movie version was created as an alternative ending to the NEON GENESIS EVANGELION TV series, remaking the final two episodes from the series. SEELE plans an attack on NERV after failing to create a man-made Third Impact. After reaffirming both her own and her mother’s existence in a state of despair, Asuka returns and begins the counterattack. However, new enemies descend from the heavens. Meanwhile, Shinji witnesses the horrifying wreckage of Asuka’s EVA-02 while piloting EVA-01. Mass production models surround EVA-01 and perform a solemn ceremony. What does it mean to complete a human heart?

#IGN #Anime
title: THE END OF EVANGELION - Official 30th Anniversary Theatrical Trailer

author: IGN
description:
Bob-omb Battlefield is a masterpiece within a masterpiece that established a new grammar for 3D movement and invoked a sense of storytelling within traditionally wordless worlds. The first level of Super Mario 64 is a dense possibility space with precisely-tailored progress that leads you across enemy lines and up a mountain in pursuit of its seven perfect stars. Bob-omb Battlefield is worth hanging on the wall.

What makes this warzone so welcoming? How many times can you climb the same hill? Do you think love can bloom, even on a battlefield? Light the fuses, man the artillery, and hold on to your flying hats, because this is The Art of the Level: Bob-omb Battlefield.

Presented by Marvel Animation's X-Men '97 Season 2.

#IGN #SuperMario64 #ArtOfTheLevel
title: Mario 64's Bob-omb Battlefield Is Gaming's Most Important 3D Platforming Level - Art of the Level

author: IGN
description:
Check out the teaser trailer for Your Mother Your Mother Your Mother, an upcoming drama action film starring Mahershala Ali, John Cho, Abubakr Ali, Laith Nakli, Tramell Tillman, Tiffany Boone, Giancarlo Esposito, Adia, and Jaheel Kamara.

From writer-director Bassam Tariq, Your Mother Your Mother Your Mother stars Mahershala Ali as Latif, a devoutly religious hitman who struggles to balance work, faith and fatherhood. When his wife dies, he embarks on a desperate journey across Houston to protect his children, confronting the forces closing in around him - and the beliefs threatening to unravel within.

Your Mother Your Mother Your Mother is produced by Lucan Toh, p.g.a., Babak Anvari, and Bassam Tariq, p.g.a. Brian O’Neill serves as executive producer.

Your Mother Your Mother Your Mother, written and directed by Bassam Tariq, opens in select theaters on September 25, and in theaters everywhere in October.

#YourMotherYourMotherYourMother #Movies #IGN
title: Your Mother Your Mother Your Mother - Official Teaser Trailer (2026) Mahershala Ali

author: IGN
description:
A world shattered by forbidden knowledge. Learn about the story and get a look at gameplay from Sword Sage: Awakening in this trailer for the upcoming action RPG rooted in Chinese mythology and folklore. Follow San Niang, a disciple of the Yuangong Sect, as she battles deadly Yaoguai, masters ancient martial arts, and uncovers the truth behind a catastrophe that changed Jiannandao forever. Sword Sage: Awakening will be available on PC.

Sword Sage: Awakening pulls players into the fantastical world of Jiannandao, a land forever changed by the Supreme White Gibbon Sage. After drunkenly unearthing long forbidden texts containing divine power and knowledge that humans were never meant to have, the lands became plagued with relentless natural disasters and monstrous infestations. The people of Jiannandao have learned to survive by forging advanced technologies to fight back against the onslaught of suffering they face.

#SwordSageAwakening #Gaming #IGN
title: Sword Sage: Awakening - Official Story Trailer
